message.content: Dense inference activates all parameters per token, maximizing compute and memory bandwidth use but with no routing overhead. Sparse expert routing activates only selected experts, reducing compute and bandwidth per token, but adds routing overhead and risks load imbalance. Dense runs uniformly; sparse saves FLOPs yet needs careful load balancing to avoid expert bottlenecks. Routing decisions cost extra compute/memory, but overall sparse can be more efficient if balanced.
